categories.main_business_segments: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-purity polysilicon, a key upstream material in the photovoltaic (solar energy) industry. The company also produces silicon core products, trichlorosilane, silicon tetrachloride, sodium hydroxide, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, and processes silicon iron, silicon manganese, silicon powder, and silicon alloys. It operates mainly in the photovoltaic materials manufacturing sector with a focus on high-purity polysilicon for solar and semiconductor applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes the modified Siemens process combined with cold hydrogenation technology to produce high-purity polysilicon. Key technological advancements include efficient chlorosilane purification, optimization of cold hydrogenation fluidized bed reactors, intelligent control of reduction furnaces, and advanced distillation control systems. The company emphasizes digitalization, automation, and intelligent manufacturing to reduce costs, improve product quality, and enhance production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are downstream silicon wafer manufacturers in the photovoltaic industry, including producers of monocrystalline and polycrystalline silicon wafers. The company serves mainly the solar energy sector, supplying materials for solar cells and modules. It also targets semiconductor-grade polysilicon markets, aiming to break foreign monopolies and expand into high-end applications such as semiconductor wafers and silicon-based battery anode materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia. It also actively expands its overseas market presence, establishing long-term cooperation with multiple foreign customers to diversify market risks. Domestic sales cover major regions including North China, Northwest, Southwest, East China, South China, Northeast, and Central China, with a small but growing portion of sales overseas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy is positioned upstream in the photovoltaic supply chain as a manufacturer of high-purity polysilicon, the essential raw material for silicon wafer production. It procures industrial silicon powder and other raw materials and supplies polysilicon directly to silicon wafer manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation focused on cost reduction, quality improvement, and energy efficiency. R&D efforts target optimization of cold hydrogenation, purification processes, intelligent furnace control, and digital twin technologies for production system management. It also invests in semiconductor-grade polysilicon development and green, low-carbon manufacturing technologies aligned with national carbon neutrality goals. Strategic emphasis is placed on digital transformation, global market expansion, and building a sustainable competitive advantage through continuous innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-purity polysilicon products to downstream silicon wafer manufacturers under long-term supply agreements and sales contracts. The company also earns income from sales of by-products generated during polysilicon production. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading polysilicon producers in China, ranking in the first tier with an 11.26% share of domestic polysilicon production in 2024. It competes with other major domestic polysilicon manufacturers, focusing on cost leadership, product quality, and technological innovation to maintain its competitive position amid industry overcapacity and price pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.41 billion, a 54.62% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.72 billion. The decline was mainly due to significant price drops in the polysilicon market and reduced sales volume. The company holds substantial cash reserves totaling around RMB 13.52 billion, demonstrating strong financial resilience despite industry challenges. Production capacity reached 305,000 tons per year, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy emphasizes high-quality, low-energy-consumption, and low-cost production of high-purity polysilicon, achieving industry-leading product quality with over 98% of output meeting electronic-grade standards. The company leverages advanced proprietary technologies, digital and intelligent manufacturing systems, and a robust R&D pipeline to deliver stable, high-performance products. Its strategic focus on semiconductor-grade polysilicon and sustainable, green manufacturing further differentiates it in the market.
